title: Projective local models under the canonical internal integral realization
statement: Let ell be prime, E/Q_ell a finite extension in any universe, X a Noetherian scheme, and K a bounded complex with finite constant constructible cohomology over the canonical continuous integral coefficient ring. There exist a finite constructible locally closed stratification and pro-etale covers on whose schemes K is the realization of a bounded complex of finitely generated projective modules over the lifted valuation ring of the canonical small presentation of E. Only the complex model is asserted: neither freeness nor its cohomology comparison nor degree-zero derived completeness is part of this conclusion.

source.place: Clause (1), projective local models before choosing bases

proof.text: For the canonical small coefficient field L, transport its DVR structure across ULift. Identify the uniformizer ideal with the maximal ideal; transport maximal-ideal adic completeness across the same ring equivalence. This gives a complete local Noetherian scalar DVR with the required unique maximal ideal.

Use integralHeart_completed_comparison to choose an exact module equivalence F with the completed scalar ring. Transport boundedness along its derived functor and each constructible cohomology module along its homology comparison isomorphism. The ordinary-module comparison makes every transported cohomology module completed-constant stratified.

Use the general DVR argument in IntegralCohomologicalAdicCriterion: a completed-constant stratified module is stratified perfect in degree zero; shifts give the other degrees. Bounded devissage and the zero, isomorphism, shift, and triangle assertions of adic_stratified_perfect imply adic constructibility, hence stratified perfectness, of F(K). This argument works for the canonical small coefficient ring without tying the original field universe to the scheme universe.

Retain the finite constructible partition and its immersions. In each covering sieve choose a generating pro-etale covering presieve; write it as a family, and use the pro-etale precoverage's existing Small instance (joint surjectivity and quasi-compact refinement) to restrict its index to the scheme universe without changing any selected cover schemes or maps. Apply the local comparison of integralHeart_completed_comparison to the bounded finite projective complex at each selected member. The complexes, bounds, and finite projectivity are retained unchanged, yielding the claimed internal integral realization.

proof_origin.place: Clause (1), using canonical-small coefficient comparison and the existing general complete DVR devissage argument.

lean.statement:
theorem integralHeart_projective_local_models
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type v) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic ℓ) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic ℓ) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : integralHeartDerivedCategory.{u} ℓ E X)
    (hK : constantModelBoundedConstructible
      (SmallAdicCompletion.Coefficients.integerRing ℓ E) X K) :
    ∃ s : Scheme.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification X,
      (∀ a : Fin s.n, Topology.IsConstructible (s.stratum a)) ∧
      ∀ a : Fin s.n, ∃ 𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage (s.domain a),
        ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
          ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (integralHeartScalars.{u} ℓ E)) ℤ)
            (b c : ℤ),
            P.IsStrictlyGE b ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE c ∧
            (∀ q : ℤ, Module.Projective (integralHeartScalars.{u} ℓ E) (P.X q) ∧
              Module.Finite (integralHeartScalars.{u} ℓ E) (P.X q)) ∧
            Nonempty (((CondensedRing.upperStar
                (SmallAdicCompletion.Coefficients.integerRing ℓ E)
                (𝒰.f i ≫ s.immersion a)).mapDerivedCategory).obj K ≅
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj
                (((integralHeartRealization.{u} ℓ E (𝒰.X i)).mapHomologicalComplex
                  (.up ℤ)).obj P))
